injuries.longComment: Smith had just 49 rushing yards heading into Saturday's game, but was given a larger role versus the subpar FCS opponent. Smith set season highs in carries and yards and scored the first touchdown of his career Saturday. With Brandon Thomas out for the season, Smith may see a slight increase in his role, but still will have to compete for carries with Asa Martin and Jeyvon Ducker. While next Saturday's regular season finale at SMU is a good matchup for the Tigers' backfield, Smith's role remains uncertain.
